proof: For fixed page, complete collapsed source word and slot, iid categorical length draws have probability product_l p_l^n_l. Conditional on the observed histogram every assignment of those labels to the fixed positions is equiprobable. Further source-invariant position strata preserve that property.

Collapse both e/i runs in both external neighbors before constructing features. All allowed target length changes then leave every neighbor feature unchanged, even when another selected occurrence is adjacent. Source neighbor words and source order may be arbitrary; the renderer must not depend on them beyond the fixed conditioning cell.

Centered one-hot labels have denominator trace(Z^T Z)=n-sum_l n_l^2/n, constant over the histogram-conditioned orbit. This denominator is positive for varying cells; singleton-label cells have no defined association ratio and require prior eligibility handling.
A full shuffle of occurrence labels samples the correct conditional law even when labels repeat: every distinct assignment has the same number of labeled-permutation representations.
A found single-swap score change proves nonconstant statistic on that cell orbit. Failure to find one is not a general proof of orbit constancy.

All predeclared varying n>=3candidate cells remain in observed and null aggregation. Mobility witnesses are solely a capacity gate. This avoids outcome-dependent selection of the scored population. The rejection event intersected with this gate cannot exceed the error rate of the fixed-statistic test; calibration conditional on passing that gate is not claimed.

Capacity must count distinct physical leaves rather than page sides and must precede null simulations. No widening after capacity failure.
Verify strict source IDs, original same-line neighbor adjacency, exact full collapsed body, exactly-one-target-run and unchanged line-position-stratum definition independently.
